distribution: independent Cartesian Gaussian displacement per atom and axis
wrapping_policy: fractional coordinates are reduced modulo one only on axes whose PBC flag is true
source_structure_sampling: stable SHA-256 ordering of inner-training IDs; without replacement
validity_policy: mathematically necessary only: finite coordinates/displacements/features, unchanged species/cell/PBC/count, nonempty valid atom and line graphs; topology change is diagnostic
label_policy: 1500 zero and 1500 one labels; independent deterministic shuffle; true labels prohibited

authoritative_orb_rule.adaptation: ALIGNN rebuilds its own atom and line graphs; mixed-PBC wrapping is implemented axis-selectively instead of reusing ORB adapter behavior
